svg.title: You declare interfaces, the generator writes the types
svg.desc: Three interfaces and what the generator writes from each. VTitle, a value object, gives Title, that a book reads and writes in place, and ReadOnlyTitle, that a BookView reads. MBook gives the class Book, a Body, the object you change; the struct BookView, a read-only view of a book; BookCollection, which enumerates the books; and BookViewCollection, which enumerates their Views. MLibraryRepository gives LibraryRepository, which opens the transactions, and its transaction, LibraryRepositoryTransaction.
